correctedState:
Do not re-file this row as written; its quote is invented. If any part is re-filed, it is the narrow user-tier gap already captured by f029, and it must be stated against what actually exists:

THE DOC'S ACTUAL CONTRACT on this page is two things, neither of which mentions `disabledMcpjsonServers`: (1) `claude mcp list` prints `\u23f8 Pending approval (run `claude` to approve)` for "a project-scoped server you haven't approved yet" (mcp-quickstart.md:66); (2) `claude mcp reset-project-choices` re-opens a previously rejected project (:367-370).

WHAT WE HAVE. A pending/rejected state DOES exist, at project granularity: `ProjectTrustState = 'none' | 'trusted' | 'blocked'` (`packages/shared/src/capabilities/types.ts:170-171`), persisted by `ProjectTrustStore` (`capabilities/project-trust-store.ts:33,114,135`), consumed as the gate at `capabilities/native-sources.ts:995`. Pre-trust, the declared `.mcp.json` / `.cursor/mcp.json` / `.vscode/mcp.json` servers are enumerated and named to the user as an `MCP_SERVER_CONFIG` detect item (`capabilities/project-contribution-detect.ts:48-50,208-209`). Post-trust, each individual server record still passes a managed allow/deny filter keyed on transport identity, not name (`packages/server-core/src/bootstrap/storage-runtime.ts:704-708` -> `isManagedMcpServerAllowed`, `agent/pi-harness/managed-policy.ts:1573`).

THE TWO REAL GAPS, both already recorded on f029 and neither of them what this row claims: (i) the per-server approve/reject list exists only at the MANAGED policy tier \u2014 there is no user/project/local-scope equivalent of `enabledMcpjsonServers` / `disabledMcpjsonServers` / `enableAllProjectMcpServers`, so an unmanaged user gets all-or-nothing project trust; (ii) that filter is skipped entirely off Pi (`storage-runtime.ts:632` `isPiCapabilityTurn = context.provider === 'pi'`, `:699` `if (!isPiCapabilityTurn) return true`), a bound already recorded in the `2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md` addendum.

A genuinely NEW observation this page supports, which the finding did not make and which would need its own row: there is no `reset-project-choices` equivalent \u2014 `ProjectTrustStore.record()` accepts only `'trusted' | 'blocked'` and cannot return a project to `'none'`. A user can flip `blocked` -> `trusted`, but cannot clear the decision back to un-asked. File that on its own quote if it matters; it is cosmetic next to (i).
